notes: Draft dictionary: Notes and Historical notes -> dc:description.
No element for alt text in the draft dictionary. Kept as its own column until you choose one.
The draft textual dictionary removes the Subjects (TGM) field. Change this element to dc:subject to merge into subjects or delete this row to drop TGM terms. Needs the PHOTO dictionary.
Draft dictionary: Date of publication -> dc:date.
The draft also sends the hidden Dates field to dc:date; kept as its own column so the display date stays readable.
